data.one_liner: A Flutter component that provides a flip card animation for showing and hiding content.
data.what_it_does: Provides a widget that can flip horizontally or vertically to reveal its back side. It supports touch-based flipping, programmatic control via a controller, auto-flipping after a delay, and hint animations.
use_when: You want to create product cards with hidden details revealed by flipping.
You need interactive flashcards or memory game elements.
You require a card that flips automatically or programmatically.
avoid_when: You need complex physics-based multi-card gestures or non-card layout animations.
You are building game-engine specific flip behaviors.
strengths: Easy to implement with declarative syntax.
Supports both horizontal and vertical flip directions.
Provides a controller to handle flipping programmatically without global keys.
Includes auto-flip and hint animation capabilities.
weaknesses: Limited to card-flipping animation use cases.
Complex card resizing illusions require correct configuration of the fill options.
